grade_rationale: 5 P1 findings exceed the C threshold (max_p1=2). 33 P2 findings also exceed C threshold (max_p2=15). Spec coverage of active plan is 100% (satisfies minimum), but P1 count alone forces grade D.

summary.skip_reason: Backend and frontend services were down at audit time — dynamic specialists require live services

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search not implemented — DependencyPicker typeahead broken in production
p1_findings.detail: FR-dependency-search: the search route is not registered. DependencyPicker calls GET /api/search?q=… on every keystroke and receives 404. 5 tests in tests/routes/search.test.ts all fail.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts, implement handler scanning workItemStore.findAll() for title/description matches filtering soft-deleted items. Register in app.ts as app.use('/api', searchRouter). Tests already written.

p1_findings.title: protobufjs — Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.detail: Untrusted protobuf deserialization triggers RCE. Infrastructure-level: orchestrator manages all agent pipelines. Fix: npm update protobufjs@latest in platform/orchestrator.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs@latest. Block all deployments until patched.

p1_findings.title: vitest — File Disclosure + Remote Code Execution (CVSS 9.1)
p1_findings.detail: vitest UI server exposes filesystem and allows RCE if accessible from untrusted network. Fix: npm update vitest@latest + disable UI in production.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd portal/Frontend && npm update vitest@latest. Add --no-ui flag or disable in vitest.config.ts for any shared/CI environment.

p1_findings.title: handlebars — JavaScript Injection via Template AST (CVSS 8.6)
p1_findings.detail: AST tampering in Handlebars allows attacker-controlled template content to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the backend process. Fix: npm update handlebars@>=4.7.9.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update 'handlebars@>=4.7.9'. Verify no user-controlled content reaches Handlebars template compilation.
p1_findings.escalate_reason: Template injection — server-side code execution risk

p1_findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js — Denial of Service via Malformed gRPC Messages (CVSS 7.5)
p1_findings.detail: Malformed or over-compressed gRPC messages crash the server. Zero-precondition — any network-reachable attacker can trigger complete availability loss for orchestrator and portal backend.
p1_findings.recommendation: npm update '@grpc/grpc-js@>=1.14.4' in both platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend.

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry tracing absent — FR-021 and architecture rule violated
p2_findings.detail: No @opentelemetry imports anywhere in Source/Backend. Architecture rule (CLAUDE.md) and FR-021 require OTel distributed tracing. Structured logging and metrics exist but tracing is entirely absent.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node + @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node. Bootstrap in tracing.ts loaded before app.ts. Add custom spans for assessment pod and workflow dispatch paths. Propagate W3C traceparent in outbound calls.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer auto-selects wrong spec file — 3 subsystem specs invisible to gate
p2_findings.detail: Enforcer picks most-recently-modified requirements.md (self-judging-workflow) and reports PASS. This hides dev-workflow-platform.md (76 FRs, portal/) and tiered-merge-pipeline.md (10 FRs, platform/) from verification. Cross-ref: QO-004.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add enforcer_files list to inspector.config.yml. Update enforcer to accept --dirs flag for multi-subsystem scanning.

p2_findings.title: workflow-engine.md canonical domain spec has no FR IDs — traceability unenforced
p2_findings.detail: Primary domain spec has rich prose but zero FR-XXX identifiers. Enforcer reports 'No FR IDs found'. Implementation traces to plan file (FR-WF-*) rather than canonical domain spec. Cross-ref: QO-003.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add FR-WF-001 through FR-WF-013 identifiers to workflow-engine.md sections matching the plan, or add a mapping block at the top.

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF injection (GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx) — affects 4 projects
p2_findings.detail: CRLF injection via form-data headers in multipart requests. Affects 4 workspaces. Fix: npm update form-data@>=4.0.6 in each.
p2_findings.recommendation: for dir in Source/Backend Source/Frontend portal/Backend portal/Frontend; do cd $dir && npm update form-data; done

p2_findings.title: browserslist memory exhaustion DoS (GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx) — affects all builds
p2_findings.detail: Malformed browser query triggers unbounded memory allocation in browserslist, causing build/test OOM. Affects all projects that use browserslist in their build tools.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update browserslist@>=4.28.7 in all workspaces.

p2_findings.title: vite dev server path traversal
p2_findings.detail: vite dev server allows path traversal to serve files outside the project root. Risk in any shared or CI environment where vite is exposed.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update vite in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend.

p2_findings.title: postcss XSS in CSS parsing
p2_findings.detail: Malformed CSS input triggers XSS via postcss output. Fix: npm update postcss.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update postcss in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend.

p2_findings.title: nanoid loop DoS
p2_findings.detail: Certain nanoid inputs trigger an infinite loop. Fix: npm update nanoid.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update nanoid in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend.

p2_findings.title: 25 additional high-severity CVEs — primarily in portal/Backend
p2_findings.detail: See Teams/TheInspector/findings/dependency-audit-2026-09-15.md for full listing. Portal/Backend has largest cluster (10 high-severity CVEs across 577 transitive deps).
p2_findings.recommendation: Run npm audit --json in portal/Backend and triage by CVSS score. Patch in descending severity order. See Teams/TheInspector/findings/dependency-audit-2026-09-15.md.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable suppresses react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 production hooks
p3_findings.detail: Stale closure bugs hidden by eslint-disable comments. Architecture rule: no disabled linting rules.
p3_findings.recommendation: Audit both locations. Wrap stable values in useCallback or use refs. Remove suppress comments.

p3_findings.title: CRUD route handlers access workItemStore directly — no service layer
p3_findings.detail: Architecture rule: no direct DB calls from route handlers. workItems.ts and intake.ts import workItemStore directly. workflow.ts correctly uses service layer. Cross-ref: QO-001 (search route should also use a service).
p3_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts wrapping store operations. Update workItems.ts and intake.ts to import from service.

p3_findings.title: Duplicate logger abstraction — compat shim and canonical both exist
p3_findings.detail: Two logger interfaces for the same thing. src/logger.ts is a compat re-export wrapper around src/utils/logger.ts. New files importing from either path get different call signatures.
p3_findings.recommendation: Pick one canonical path. Delete the compat shim. Migrate all import paths. Verify tests still pass.

escalations.reason: P1 RCE (CVSS 9.8) — protobufjs deserialization in platform/orchestrator
P1 File Disclosure + RCE (CVSS 9.1) — vitest UI in portal/Frontend
P1 Template injection (CVSS 8.6) — handlebars in Source/Backend

cross_references.single_fix: Add FR-WF-* IDs to workflow-engine.md + update enforcer for multi-target mode
Create workItemService.ts + searchService.ts — unifies store access, implements missing route
npm update vitest vite postcss nanoid in portal/Frontend and Source/Frontend
